name: Startup Listing

sources.title: Homepage — curated directory of SaaS/micro-SaaS/side projects (790+ products, 3,737+ builders); 'Submit your startup' → /products/new
Pricing — 'Listing Fee: $4.00 → FREE'; 'Start with our free plan'; Featured upgrade $3/day ($21/7 days)

requirements: SaaS tools, micro-SaaS, indie side projects — broad fit
Base listing is free ($4.00 fee waived per pricing page); 'Featured' placement is paid at $3/day
preparation: Product name, URL, tagline/description, category (SaaS & Tools, AI & ML, Developer Tools, etc.)
Optional deal/coupon if you want a 'Top Deals' slot
workflow: Open 'Submit your startup' (/products/new) and fill the product form
Choose the free listing (skip the $3/day Featured upgrade)
Product publishes as a /p/<id> page; supports reviews, categories, tags, leaderboard
watchFor: Pricing page mixes free + paid in one checkout-style UI — don't accidentally buy Featured days
Upgrade is per-product (FAQ: 'separate plans for multiple products')
'Get Backlinks Now' CTA on homepage — likely badge/featured upsell
Typical reciprocal-badge ecosystem in footer; low-moderation vibe (mixed-quality listings visible)
countsAsLive: The product has a public startuplist.ing/p/<id> page and appears in 'All Products' / its category listing
unknowns: Whether free listing links are dofollow (seed says nofollow)
